capabilities: Push the active note to a reMarkable tablet via ribbon icon or command
Show live reMark Bridge sync status in the status bar
Refresh sync status by command or status-bar click
Configure the bridge server URL and bearer token in settings
Retry failed pushes with exponential back-off and surface errors as notices
disambiguation: Not the sync server itself; it is a client for a separately running reMark Bridge instance on your own machine, VPS, or Docker stack.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Docs cover setup, usage, retry behavior, and offline troubleshooting, but the bridge server itself must be installed and a token issued separately.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send notes to a reMarkable tablet or watch an external sync bridge's status from inside the app.

relations.evidence: This plugin talks HTTP to a running reMark Bridge instance (≥ v0.6.0)
Push the active Obsidian note to your reMarkable tablet with a single command

requires.name: bearer token issued by the bridge server

summary: Companion plugin that pushes the active note to a reMarkable tablet via a self-hosted reMark Bridge server and shows its sync status in the status bar.
